# Minuette (G4)

Minuette is the relentlessly cheerful, light-blue unicorn who used to be friends with Twilight Sparkle in Canterlot. Recognize her by her dark-blue and pale-lavender mane and tail, violet eyes, and golden hourglass cutie mark. Once a recurring background pony, she becomes an outgoing, forgiving supporting character in *Amending Fences*.

[![Minuette (left) with Twinkleshine and Lemon Hearts](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2021/2/18/2273924/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/2273924)
*Show still from “Amending Fences”; screen animation credited to the* Friendship Is Magic *production, not the image uploader.*

## Names and appearances

“Colgate” was a fan nickname inspired by her toothpaste-like striped mane; “Romana” was another fan nickname inspired by *Doctor Who* and her hourglass mark. Neither is a confirmed alter ego or canonical dentist/time-traveler identity. The merchandise name **Minuette** was publicized in [2011 blind-bag coverage](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2011/11/blindbags-set-3-namessummariesimages.html?m=0), appeared on [2012 figures](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/Name/minuetteFIMmini.html), and was spoken in the television series in *Amending Fences* (2015).

She appears in the pilot and various background scenes; notably, she is one of the original bridesmaids at the Canterlot wedding (*A Canterlot Wedding*, S2E25–26). She **does speak**: Cathy Weseluck voices her brief S2E25 dialogue, while Rebecca Husain voices her substantial S5E12 role. See the [character and voice reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Minuette).

## Important moments

All four are from *“Amending Fences” (S5E12)*. Watch the [official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AIY5iEEzNlo); the [episode dialogue](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s05e12&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic) confirms the scenes. *Timestamp deep links unavailable: offsets could not be verified against the official upload.*

1. **A delighted reunion:** Minuette greets Twilight enthusiastically, wants a photo with her new princess friend, and proposes visiting Lemon Hearts and Twinkleshine.
2. **A gracious response to an apology:** At the doughnut shop, she and the others reassure Twilight that her abrupt departure stung but did not destroy their friendship.
3. **Understanding Moon Dancer:** Minuette explains how Moon Dancer started opening up before the party Twilight skipped, helping Twilight understand why repairing that friendship matters.
4. **Old friends, new party:** Minuette and Pinkie Pie recognize each other from Cadance’s wedding and help gather friends for the party that allows Moon Dancer to reconnect.
